topics.label: Introduction and Lecture Overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic welcomes the students, sets the scope of the lecture on the initiation and resolution of inflammation, and explains how previously introduced concepts fit together.

topics.label: Innate Recognition of Pathogens and Cellular Damage
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the molecular targets, receptors, and signaling mechanisms used by the innate immune system to detect infection and tissue injury.

topics.label: Acute Inflammatory Signaling and Leukocyte Trafficking
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how the acute inflammatory response coordinates the recruitment and trafficking of immune cells, as well as the systemic risks when this activation becomes excessive.

topics.label: Resolution of Inflammation and Chronic Tissue Responses
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how acute inflammation is terminated and the tissue repair or chronic inflammatory states that follow.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the concluding framing for the lecture and announces the upcoming topic.
